env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./l/...
logos build ./g/...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/pure$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/pure$GOEXE
stdout '^run-ok: 2 2$'
cd ..

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/m.a ./l/m
logos build -o $WORK/vp.a ./g/vp
logos build -o $WORK/n.a ./l/n
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/m.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Good\.Sum Readonly,ParamMutated=0$'
go tool pack p $WORK/vp.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn .*Grab AssertTP=0,AssertRTP=0$'
! stdout 'ParamMutated'
go tool pack p $WORK/n.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn U\.Go .*ParamMutated=1$'
stdout '^fn V\.Go .*ParamMutated=1$'
stdout '^fn Z\.Go Readonly,ParamMutated=0$'

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/pure

go 1.27

-- w/l/m/m.lgo --
package m

type Good struct {
	name string
}

func Make(name string) Good {
	return Good{name: name}
}

func (g Good) Name() string {
	return g.name
}

func (g Good) Sum(b []byte) int {
	return len(b)
}

-- w/l/n/n.lgo --
package n

import (
	"example.com/pure/m"
	"example.com/pureg/vp"
)

type Z struct {
	g m.Good
}

func (z Z) Go(b []byte) int {
	if z.g.Sum(b) != len(b) {
		return -1
	}
	return len(b)
}

type U struct {
	box vp.Box
}

func (u U) Go(b []byte) int {
	if u.box.Eat(b) != len(b) {
		return -1
	}
	return len(b)
}

type V struct {
	box vp.Box
}

func (v V) Go(b []byte) int {
	r := v.box.Grab(b)
	if len(r) != len(b) {
		return -1
	}
	return len(b)
}

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/pure/m"
	"example.com/pureg/vp"
)

func main() {
	g := m.Make("ada")
	fmt.Println("run-ok:", g.Sum([]byte{1, 2}), vp.Box{}.Eat([]byte{3, 4}))
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/pureg

go 1.27

-- w/g/vp/vp.go --
package vp

type Box struct{}

func (Box) Eat(b []byte) int {
	return len(b)
}

func (Box) Grab[T any](x T) T {
	return x
}
